items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Brief D1-D10 and S1 acceptance items 1-19 each map to a test in shared/tests (resolver, files, CLI, schema, gitignore) plus 9 boundary probes.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Winning file never falls through; unreadable project dir, directory/dangling-link entries, missing or corrupt schema all raise ProfileError with kind and exit_code.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Strict name regex, reserved/device names, resolve-once containment, exact-spelling check, shadow warnings returned for loaders; resolver never spawns or expands env.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: CLI tested in-process plus one subprocess smoke; hand checker cross-checked against jsonschema on bundled profiles and 21 mutations.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Schema parsed once via lru_cache; directory listings only, no globbing of the tree.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Three modules each under 300 lines; hot-file rule documented to cover all three.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer shared/profiles and consumer resolver round-tripped on the bundled files; gitignore negation proven in a scratch git repo with the rendered template; list --json contract pinned.
